i.norm: Verifies that a name containing punctuation and lowercase letters is considered phonetically equivalent to a name with a double consonant. ",-l" is cleaned to "L" (punctuation stripped, uppercased). "RR" is reduced to "R" (double consonant collapsed to single). Both encode to single-letter consonants whose combined length (2) yields a minimum rating of 5; the similarity comparison also scores 5, so they match.
",-l" cleans to "L"; "RR" reduces to "R" — both score at the minimum rating threshold
